main.title: The main method
main.text:
This is the program's **entry point**. It:

1. [prints a greeting](#greet)
2. [loops five times](#loop)

Take the [guided tour](#tour1) for a step-by-step walkthrough.

greet.title: Printing a greeting
greet.text: `IO.println` prints a line to the console. The text is [this string literal](6:30-6:49).

loop.title: A `for` loop
loop.text:
Counts `i` from 1 to 5. The highlighted outline shows where `i` is used.

Each pass [prints the counter](#print).

print.title: Check your understanding
print.text:
What does this line print on the **third** pass of the loop?

It uses [string concatenation](#concat). The test data is in [temp.txt](#data).
hints: `i` starts at 1 and goes up by one each pass.
`"i = " + i` joins the text and the number.

data.text: Junk test data in another file.

tour1.title: Tour 1/3: the signature
tour1.text: `void main()` declares a method with no return value. Java runs it first.

tour3.title: Tour 3/3: the loop
tour3.text: Prints `i = 1` to `i = 5`. That's the end of the tour!
